Change c0276. Location: 1818 Vol. II, Ch. VII; 1831 Ch. XV.

Context before (unchanged): "As I read, however, I applied much personally to my own feelings and condition.

1818 text: I found myself similar, yet at the same time strangely unlike the beings concerning whom I read, and to whose conversation I was a listener. I sympathized with, and partly understood them, but I was unformed in mind; I was dependent on none, and related to none.

1831 text: I found myself similar, yet at the same time strangely unlike to the beings concerning whom I read, and to whose conversation I was a listener. I sympathised with, and partly understood them, but I was unformed in mind; I was dependent on none, and related to none.

Diff: I found myself similar, yet at the same time strangely unlike {+to+} the beings concerning whom I read, and to whose conversation I was a listener. I [-sympathized-] {+sympathised+} with, and partly understood them, but I was unformed in mind; I was dependent on none, and related to none.

Context after (unchanged): 'The path of my departure was free;' and there was none to lament my annihilation.

result.rationale: Mostly orthographic: 'sympathized' becomes 'sympathised' (-ize to -ise). The insertion of 'to' after 'unlike' is a minor grammatical/syntactic tweak with no change in meaning.
